summary: Adds procedural noise fields or attributes to POP data. Useful for particle motion, variation, and organic displacement in POP chains.

key_params.name: offset
key_params.note: Offset for animating or shifting the field

key_params.name: noisesize
key_params.note: Number of components in the generated noise value when available

common_gotchas: Noise can push particles out of view; validate finite POP bounds after applying it.
Animated POP noise should be checked for stable cook time and non-NaN attributes.
